summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that a securities class action complaint was filed in New York state court on July 23, 2026, naming over 30 U.S.-listed companies, more than 10 broker-dealers, and individuals as defendants. The company was served on August 11, 2026, and is reviewing the merits; it cannot estimate potential loss. No special-situation transaction is described; this is a routine current report regarding litigation, not a corporate event falling into a defined special-situations category.
